issues.title: EU AI Act Compliance (High-Risk Systems)
issues.hover_description: EU AI Act in force from Aug 2024, phased enforcement through 2026-2027. High-risk AI systems (recruitment, credit, biometrics) require conformity assessment, human oversight, and transparency documentation. Fines up to €30M or 3% global revenue. Both high financial AND high societal (fundamental rights) materiality. ESRS S1 + EU AI Act Art. 9.

issues.title: Data Privacy & Surveillance Risk
issues.hover_description: GDPR mega-fines (up to 4% global revenue). User data harvesting for ad targeting. EU Data Act 2025 creates additional portability obligations. ESRS S4 + G1 mandatory.

issues.title: Cloud Infrastructure Energy & Scope 2
issues.hover_description: Data centres consume 1-2% of global electricity. Hyperscaler dependency creates Scope 2 exposure. RE100 commitments require 100% renewable matching. Carbon tax at $250/ton makes this financially material. ESRS E1.

issues.title: Digital Divide & Accessibility Gap
issues.hover_description: Product inaccessibility for 1.3B disabled users globally. EU Web Accessibility Directive + EAA (European Accessibility Act) enforcement. High societal; medium financial. ESRS S4.

issues.title: Cybersecurity & Operational Resilience
issues.hover_description: NIS2 Directive mandatory from Oct 2024. Ransomware exposure. High financial risk (operational disruption + fines). Societal impact: moderate. ESRS G1.

issues.title: Competitor AI Platform Market Share
issues.hover_description: Pure competitive/financial risk. No direct ESG harm. Rapid AI commoditisation. ESRS 2 SBM-3.

issues.title: Annual Social Media ESG Campaign
issues.hover_description: Marketing spend. No material ESG outcome. Greenwashing risk if structural issues unresolved.

issues.title: Executive Travel Carbon Offsets
issues.hover_description: Symbolic. Cloud energy is orders of magnitude larger. Greenwashing red flag.

interdependencies.description: AI Act high-risk classification amplifies GDPR data processing obligations
